description: This file defines the TimesheetEntriesParamRule class, which extends an abstract validation rule to validate entries related to timesheet time entries, ensuring proper structure, project and activity IDs, date format, date range, duration format, and consistency with existing timesheet data within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: TimesheetEntriesParamRule
classes.description: A validation rule class that verifies the structure and semantic correctness of timesheet entry data, including project and activity IDs, dates, durations, and their relationship with existing timesheet periods.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the validation rule with a specific timesheet ID to potentially fetch the timesheet date range for validation.

methods.name: getApiDateRule
methods.description: Lazy-loads and returns an instance of ApiDate used for validating date formats.

methods.name: getTimeRule
methods.description: Lazy-loads and returns an instance of Time used for validating duration formats.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Main validation method that checks the input entries array for correct structure, required fields, valid IDs, date formats, date boundaries within the associated timesheet, and valid durations, as well as cross-referencing project and activity IDs.
